subproblem.title: Canonical integer representation of an integral varifold with mass domination (step 6)
subproblem.statement: Assume (hD): every integral n-varifold V on any U ⊆ ℝ^N has, for μ_V-a.e. x, HasDensity n μ_V x k for some integer k ≥ 1 [the frozen statement of the accepted sibling intcpt_integral_density_integer]; and (hC): every n-varifold V on any U with locally bounded first variation and Θ^n(μ_V,x) > 0 for μ_V-a.e. x admits θ : ℝ^N → ℝ with IsVarifoldOf V M_V θ, M_V := {x ∈ spt μ_V : V has a tangent plane at x}, such that every x ∈ M_V has a tangent plane with multiplicity θ(x) and HasDensity n μ_V x (ofReal θ(x)), and every μ_V-null Z ⊆ M_V is H^n-null [the frozen statement of the accepted sibling intcpt_canonical_tangent_representation with AllardRectifiabilityTheorem and FirstRectifiabilityTheorem discharged]. Then for every integral n-varifold W on U with locally bounded first variation there is θ : ℝ^N → ℝ with IsVarifoldOf W M θ (M := M_W), every x ∈ M has a tangent plane with multiplicity θ(x) and HasDensity n μ_W x (ofReal θ(x)), H^n({x ∈ M : there is no integer m ≥ 1 with θ(x) = m}) = 0, and ∫⁻ u dμ_W ≤ ∫⁻_{M ∩ K} u·ofReal(θ) dH^n for every compact K ⊆ U and every Borel u : ℝ^N → [0,∞] vanishing off K. Notation: H^n := μHE[n]; G(N,n) := Grassmannian N n; p_S := Grassmannian.project S (orthogonal projection onto S.plane); t_P(S) := ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap(projectionLinearMap S − projectionLinearMap P)‖ (operator norm of p_S − p_P); μ_W := W.weight; ‖δW‖ := variationMeasure W; v(T) := planeVarifoldMeasure T; B_ρ(y) := closedBall y ρ, B°_ρ(y) := ball y ρ; unitBallVolume n is the extended-real volume of the open unit ball of ℝ^n; ofReal := ENNReal.ofReal.
subproblem.lean_statement: (∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U), IsIntegral V → ∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k ∧ HasDensity n V.weight x (k : ℝ≥0∞)) → (∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n V.weight x θ ∧ 0 < θ) → ∃ θ : Euclidean N → ℝ, IsVarifoldOf V {x | x ∈ V.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ'} θ ∧ (∀ x ∈ {x | x ∈ V.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ'}, (∃ T : Grassmannian N n, HasTangentPlane V x T (θ x)) ∧ HasDensity n V.weight x (ENNReal.ofReal (θ x))) ∧ ∀ Z ⊆ {x | x ∈ V.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ'}, V.weight Z = 0 → (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) Z = 0) → ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (W : Varifold N n U), IsIntegral W → W.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → ∃ θ : Euclidean N → ℝ, IsVarifoldOf W {x | x ∈ W.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane W x T θ'} θ ∧ (∀ x ∈ {x | x ∈ W.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane W x T θ'}, (∃ T : Grassmannian N n, HasTangentPlane W x T (θ x)) ∧ HasDensity n W.weight x (ENNReal.ofReal (θ x))) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) {x | x ∈ {x | x ∈ W.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane W x T θ'} ∧ ¬ ∃ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m ∧ θ x = m} = 0 ∧ ∀ (K : Set (Euclidean N)) (u : Euclidean N → ℝ≥0∞), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → Measurable u → (∀ x, x ∉ K → u x = 0) → ∫⁻ x, u x ∂W.weight ≤ ∫⁻ x in {x | x ∈ W.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane W x T θ'} ∩ K, u x * ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N))
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 6 of the supplied proof of the parent theorem intcpt_flat_limit_integer_multiplicity (canonical form of W via integral_density and canonical_representation; Z is μ-null hence H^n-null; μ⌞B ≤ (H^n⌞(M̃ ∩ B)).withDensity(ofReal θ̃)). Notation: G := Grassmannian N n (compact, Grassmannian.instCompactSpace); H^n := μHE[n]; unitBallVolume n is the extended-real volume of the open unit ball of EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) and ω := (unitBallVolume n).toReal; μ_V := V.weight = V.measure.map Prod.fst; B_ρ(y) := closedBall y ρ, B°_ρ(y) := ball y ρ; v(T) := planeVarifoldMeasure T = (H^n⌞T.plane).map (y ↦ (y,T)); p_S := Grassmannian.project S = Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap S; t_P(S) := ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap S − Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap P)‖ (operator norm of p_S − p_P).
1. By (hD) for W, μ_W-a.e. x has HasDensity n μ_W x k with k ∈ ℕ, k ≥ 1; then (k : [0,∞]) > 0, so the density hypothesis of (hC) holds for W.
2. (hC) for W gives θ with IsVarifoldOf W M θ, the tangent-plane and density property at every x ∈ M, and the null transfer property. These are the first two conclusions.
3. Let Z := {x ∈ M : ¬∃ m ∈ ℕ, m ≥ 1 ∧ θ(x) = m}. Then μ_W(Z) = 0: by 1, for μ_W-a.e. x there is k ≥ 1 with HasDensity n μ_W x k; if such an x lay in Z, then x ∈ M gives also HasDensity n μ_W x (ofReal θ(x)); limits along the non-trivial filter 𝓝[>]0 in the Hausdorff space [0,∞] are unique (tendsto_nhds_unique), so ofReal θ(x) = k; θ(x) > 0 by IsVarifoldOf, so θ(x) = toReal(ofReal θ(x)) = k, contradicting x ∈ Z. Thus μ_W-a.e. x ∉ Z (measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem). As Z ⊆ M, the null transfer property of 2 gives H^n(Z) = 0.
4. Domination. Fix K compact ⊆ U and u Borel, u = 0 off K. By IsVarifoldOf, θ is H^n-integrable on M ∩ K, so ofReal ∘ θ is a.e.-measurable for H^n⌞(M ∩ K). Let ν := (H^n⌞(M ∩ K)).withDensity(ofReal ∘ θ).
5. μ_W⌞K ≤ ν. For Borel B: μ_W⌞K(B) = μ_W(B ∩ K) = W.measure((B ∩ K) × G) (Varifold.weight_apply; K is closed). By IsVarifoldOf with the Borel set A := (B ∩ K) × G this equals ∫⁻ over {x ∈ M : ∃ S, (weighted approximate tangent at x) ∧ (x,S) ∈ A} of ofReal θ dH^n; that set is contained in B ∩ (M ∩ K), so (lintegral_mono_set) μ_W⌞K(B) ≤ ∫⁻_{B ∩ (M ∩ K)} ofReal θ dH^n = ν(B) (Measure.restrict_restrict, withDensity_apply). Measure.le_iff gives μ_W⌞K ≤ ν.
6. Since support u ⊆ K, ∫⁻ u dμ_W = ∫⁻_K u dμ_W (setLIntegral_eq_of_support_subset) ≤ ∫⁻ u dν (lintegral_mono' with the measure inequality) = ∫⁻_{M ∩ K} ofReal(θ)·u dH^n (lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul₀; ofReal ∘ θ is a.e.-measurable and u is measurable) = ∫⁻_{M ∩ K} u·ofReal(θ) dH^n.

Implementation aid (optional; not part of the proof): a kernel-checked Lean proof of this exact statement following these steps is Submission.intcpt_fli_integral_canonical_domination in the git-ignored file GMT/Scratch/FLI_Decomp.lean of the gmt-ch08 workspace (copy: /tmp/fli-decomp/FullCmp.lean), if still present.
proof_key_steps: (hD) gives positive integer densities μ_W-a.e., so (hC) applies and yields θ, M and the tangent/density/null-transfer properties.
Points of M where θ is not a positive integer form a μ_W-null set (uniqueness of density limits), hence an H^n-null set.
IsVarifoldOf gives μ_W⌞K ≤ (H^n⌞(M ∩ K)).withDensity(ofReal θ) on Borel sets.
Integrate a Borel u vanishing off K against this inequality and expand the withDensity integral.

audit.reason: Both external contracts are explicit hypotheses. Density uniqueness and positivity establish integer multiplicity outside a Hausdorff-null set. The Borel-set measure comparison and justified withDensity integral identity prove domination for every stated K and u.
